mapper.select: SELECT id FROM kpi_definition WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kpi_value_history (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at, archived_at) SELECT kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at, NOW() FROM kpi_value WHERE kpi_id = #{kpiId} AND dimension = #{dimensionJson}::jsonb
mapper.update: INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, #{dimensionJson}::jsonb AS dimension, ROUND( COALESCE( SUM(CASE WHEN page_url ~ '^/features?/' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 0 ), 4) AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM access_log WHERE created_at >= #{targetDate}::date AND created_at < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()

INSERT INTO kpi_value (kpi_id, dimension, value_numeric, value_text, calculated_at) SELECT #{kpiId} AS kpi_id, #{dimensionJson}::jsonb AS dimension, COUNT(*)::numeric AS value_numeric, NULL AS value_text, NOW() AS calculated_at FROM audit_log WHERE action = 'EXPORT' AND event_time >= #{targetDate}::date AND event_time < #{targetDate}::date + INTERVAL '1 day' ON CONFLICT (kpi_id, dimension) DO UPDATE SET value_numeric = EXCLUDED.value_numeric, value_text = EXCLUDED.value_text, calculated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = #{tableName}
INSERT INTO batch_execution_log (job_name, job_group, started_at, status, triggered_by) VALUES ('KPI_AGGREGATION', 'STATS', #{startedAt}, 'RUNNING', 'SCHEDULE') RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE batch_execution_log SET status = #{status}, finished_at = NOW(), duration_ms = (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - started_at)) * 1000)::int, records_processed = #{recordsProcessed}, records_failed = #{recordsFailed}, error_summary = #{errorSummary} WHERE id = #{id}
